source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary: In your [Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase), choose Huron’s Elite or Mobile Marauders. The choice applies to your HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY units and lasts until your next [Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase) begins. At each phase opening, check what your HURON BLACKHEART can see. Eligible visible units have both abilities for that phase. Huron’s Elite gives the unit’s attacks +1 to Hit. Mobile Marauders lets the unit shoot and charge on its Fall Back turn. If the unit got this permission through HURON BLACKHEART, moved out of his sight by Falling Back and needs the permission to shoot or charge, the unit must be visible to HURON BLACKHEART when the relevant [Shooting](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase) or [Charge phase](vsdata:core-rule/charge-phase) begins.
